ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle RST, point V is on side ST, line segment RV is connected, and RV passes through point Z; the figure also draws other line segments from vertices to opposite sides, and they intersect at Z. The problem gives that Z is the centroid (centroid) of triangle RST, and RZ = 18. Reasoning: Because Z is the centroid, it divides each median into two segments in a 2:1 ratio, with the part from the vertex to the centroid being longer. Therefore on median RV, RZ:ZV = 2:1. Given RZ = 18, so ZV = 18 ÷ 2 = 9.

raw_record.question_text: In $\triangle RST$, $Z$ is the centroid and $RZ=18$. Find $ZV$.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify triangle RST with point V on side ST and the segment from vertex R through Z to V drawn, so ZV lies on the median from R to side ST. From the text, use that Z is the centroid and RZ = 18. Apply the centroid division rule: a centroid divides each median in a 2:1 ratio, with the longer part from the vertex to the centroid. Thus RZ:ZV = 2:1, so ZV = 18/2 = 9.

method.method_draft: From the image, see that Z lies on segment RV, where V is on side ST, so RV is the median associated with vertex R. From the text, Z is the centroid and RZ = 18. Use an affine-coordinate model along the median: let V be coordinate 0 and R be coordinate L on the line RV. Since V is the midpoint of ST for the median, the centroid has coordinate L/3 measured from V toward R. Therefore ZV = L/3 and RZ = L - L/3 = 2L/3. Given 2L/3 = 18, get L = 27, hence ZV = L/3 = 9.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是三角形 RST，点 V 在边 ST 上，线段 RV 经过内部点 Z；题目给出 Z 是三角形的 centroid，且 RZ=18。推理：因为 Z 是重心，并且 Z 位于从顶点 R 到边 ST 上点 V 的线段 RV 上，所以 RV 是从 R 出发的中线。沿 RV 建立一维坐标：令 V 的坐标为 0，R 的坐标为 L。重心在中线上距对边中点 V 为整条中线的 1/3，所以 Z 的坐标为 L/3。因此 ZV=L/3，RZ=L-L/3=2L/3。已知 RZ=18，所以 2L/3=18，得 L=27。于是 ZV=L/3=9。
